rule: A premise of type structural_rule is supplied by the law. Selection rules, representation choices and numerical inputs may be supplied by the designer as implementable calibration. Empirical imports and external mathematics are imports. The overrides below assign premises that would encode an observed outcome to the law, because supplying them would hardcode what the theorems or the observers are to produce.

PR-12.reason: the matter grammar would fix the observed matter content

PR-13.reason: the Koide balance constrains one combination of three positive lepton masses

PR-36.reason: the family band selection would fix the number of families

PR-37.reason: the closure map selection would fix the fine-structure constant

PR-41.reason: the electroweak selection premises fix observed electroweak values

PR-48.reason: the one-Higgs carrier fixes the observed scalar content

PR-50.reason: the Yukawa coefficients fix particle masses

PR-55.reason: baryon and lepton labels fix observed quantum numbers

PR-59.reason: the exterior mask grammar fixes the observed matter representation

PR-67.reason: the one-doublet grammar fixes the observed electroweak content

PR-69.reason: a Yukawa-line coefficient fixes a particle mass
